headline: Tencent surges; DeepSeek bleeds share across the board
summary: Tencent's hy3 jumped two spots to rank 4 with a 1.2% token-share bump, while DeepSeek's portfolio contracted 1.5% in a single day—the flash variant sank three ranks. Anthropic also posted solid gains, with Claude Opus climbing into the top 15 and three new models entering the rankings (Meta's Muse Spark, a fresh Anthropic variant, and OpenAI's GPT-OSS-20B).
highlights: DeepSeek overall -1.5% daily share; flash variant -3 ranks to #7
Anthropic/claude-opus-5 +3 ranks to #12; claude-4.8-opus +11 ranks to #25
Three new entrants: meta/muse-spark-1.2, anthropic/claude-4.6-opus, openai/gpt-oss-20b
Three dropouts: DeepSeek flash-vision-exp, Moonshot kimi-k2.6, OpenAI text-embedding-3-small
Stealth still dominates at 32.3% share (−0.9% daily)
